description: PayNow peer-to-peer real-time payments launched
SGQR unified national QR code launched
PromptPay real-time transfers live (registration opened 2016)
DuitNow real-time transfers launched by PayNet
DuitNow QR established as national QR standard under BNM ICTF
QRIS national QR standard launched by Bank Indonesia
QRIS becomes mandatory for QR payment providers
PESONet batch electronic fund transfers launched
InstaPay real-time transfers launched
QR Ph national QR standard launched for person-to-person payments (BSP Circular 1055)
VietQR national QR standard launched by NAPAS
Bakong central-bank payment system officially launched
KHQR national QR standard rolled out to all Bakong members (corrected from 2020 in P2)
LAO QR national QR system officially launched by Bank of the Lao PDR
MyanmarPay MMQR national QR system officially introduced (corrected from 2025-03-04 in P2)
PayNow-PromptPay cross-border real-time link (Singapore-Thailand)
MAS announces successful digital bank licence applicants (operations from 2022)
BNM announces five digital bank licences (operations after 12-24 month readiness period)
BSP Circular 1105 digital bank framework takes effect (licences granted 2021)
OJK POJK 12/2021 enabling digital banks takes effect (issued 2021-08-19)
Bank of Thailand approves three virtual bank applicants (operating licences expected 2026)
DOTC orders LTFRB to create Transport Network Company / TNVS category legalising app ride-hailing
Revised Ministry of Transport rules on online car taxis take effect (PM 32/2016 announced 2016-04-01; revision effective 2017-04-01)
Motorbike ride-hailing regulated for the first time (PM 12/2019 signed)
E-hailing licensing regime takes effect (three-month grace for driver permits)
Decree 10/2020 on automobile transport business takes effect (legal basis for ride-hailing)
Ministerial Regulation legalising ride-hailing via electronic systems published in Royal Gazette
E-scooters banned from footpaths
OJK regulation on P2P lending (POJK 77/2016) issued
BSP Circular 944 requires virtual-currency exchanges to register
Digital Asset Business Emergency Decree takes effect (licensing regime)
Digital currencies and tokens prescribed as securities; SC regulates digital asset exchanges
Bappebti Regulation 5/2019 on physical crypto asset markets issued
Payment Services Act takes effect (licensing of digital payment token services)
BSP Circular 1108 VASP guidelines take effect
BSP moratorium on new VASP licences (three years)
Crypto supervision moves from Bappebti to OJK
Resolution 05/2025 crypto asset market pilot takes effect (5-year pilot)
Law on Digital Technology Industry takes effect (first legal framework for digital assets)
